name: chatroom
description: A lightweight real-time room-based chat application

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server "npm run dev -w @chatroom/client" "npm run dev -w @chatroom/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chatroom/shared && npm run build -w @chatroom/server && npm run build -w @chatroom/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @chatroom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @chatroom/server && npm run typecheck -w @chatroom/client
